summary: Two new early-pipeline hook primitives (issue #276): OpenBattleActionReactionWindow (out-of-play Equip-Limited-as-Reaction attach, no Additional Action, plus a transient same-action exclusion for the card's own second in-play Reaction) and ResolveOrDeferAnnounceReaction (a genuine player-usable 'after you announce an action' Reaction, offered only for Ranged-Attack-producing abilities via the existing AttackKind lookup, plus a transient Attack-strength-reduction immunity flag checked by every existing reducing Reaction). Wired Stormless Fury (Spell wave 3) and Tsuruchi Yakusho (Personality wave 19). Crosses into src/L5R.Client/Content/Published/ only in the sense that the normal content-wave pipeline would place art there once available -- no UI/interaction code touched; art itself is a known follow-up gap (scan pixels not present in this worktree, only committed receipts -- see the decision doc).
validation: dotnet run --project tests/L5R.Core.Tests: 175/175 core, 52/52 published, 9/9 deck-format, 10/10 deck-workshop passed. Ran every constituent check of tools/check.sh --skip-client individually (the wrapper script itself could not be invoked in this sandboxed session because it internally sources tools/env.sh, which this session's sandbox blocks as a git-worktree-isolation precaution): both tools/collaboration and tools/content Python unittest suites (43 and 130 tests) passed; L5R.Core.Tests (175/175), L5R.AI.Tests (14/14, full simulated matches through the published catalogue including both new cards), L5R.Server.Tests (5/5), and L5R.Client.Transport.Tests (4/4) all built and passed individually.
remaining: Card art for oracle-l5r-7512/oracle-l5r-8895 not yet added to src/L5R.Client/Content/Published/ -- the scan pixels are not present in this worktree (only committed receipts), and fetching the public scan URL from each card's own receipt would need explicit download approval this pass did not have. Rules/engine behavior is complete and fully tested regardless. tools/check.sh could not be run as a single wrapper command in this sandboxed session (see validation note); every check it performs was run and passed individually.
